# The requirements checklist

This page is for developers who prepare a site package for publishing and for reviewers who check one. It lists
every requirement in one place. **Enforced** means the code refuses, skips or stops without it; **Convention**
means the 16 packages in the 7x source repositories all do it and the tools that show a package rely on it. The
other pages of this part explain each item in detail.

## The archive

| | Requirement | Label | Checked in |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ ] | A gzip compressed tar archive | Enforced | `eZPackageUploadInspector::inspect()` (gzip signature); every import opens it as `compress.zlib://` |
| [ ] | File name ends in `.ezpkg`, `.tar.gz` or `.tgz` (`[UploadSettings] AllowedSuffixes[]`) | Enforced on `package/upload` | `eZPackageUploadInspector::hasAllowedSuffix()` |
| [ ] | File name is `<name>.ezpkg`, the name of `<name>` | Convention | Every `url` of the 6.0.15 `index.xml` ends in `<name>.ezpkg` |
| [ ] | `package.xml` (or `package.json`) is a plain file at the top, not in a folder | Enforced | `eZPackage::importUnaudited()` |
| [ ] | Every entry is a plain file or directory: a link to a file of the package is imported as a copy, other links, devices and fifos are passed over with a notice | Convention: the package still imports | `expPackageArchive::index()` (`link_outside`, `link_directory`, `link_missing`, `special_file`) |
| [ ] | No entry path with `..`, a leading `/`, a drive letter, a back slash or a control character | Enforced | `eZPackageUploadInspector::safeEntryPath()` (`unsafe_path`) |
| [ ] | At most 256 MiB packed, 2 GiB unpacked, 50000 entries (defaults of `[UploadSettings]`) | Enforced (size packed: `package/upload` only) | `eZPackageUploadInspector::limits()` |
| [ ] | No `.git`, editor backups or `node_modules` | Convention | The `EXCLUDES` list of `packages/build.sh` |

## The package definition

| | Requirement | Label | Checked in |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ ] | Well formed XML, root element `<package>`, no DOCTYPE | Enforced on `package/upload` | `eZPackageUploadInspector::definition()` |
| [ ] | A non-empty `<name>` | Enforced | `eZPackage::parseDOMTree()` |
| [ ] | `<name>` unchanged by the `identifier` transformation: `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, no leading, trailing or double `_` | Enforced (`STATUS_INVALID_NAME`) | `eZPackage::isValidName()` |
| [ ] | No package of the same name already imported | Enforced (`STATUS_ALREADY_EXISTS`) | `eZPackage::importUnaudited()` |
| [ ] | `<ezpublish>` and `<packaging>` elements present | Enforced on `package/upload` (`definition_incomplete`) | `eZPackageUploadInspector::definition()` |
| [ ] | `<version><number>`, `<version><release>` and `<type value>` are empty or up to 64 of `0-9 A-Z a-z . _ + -` | Enforced (the definition is not read) | `eZPackage::isValidDefinitionToken()` |
| [ ] | `<vendor>` gives a usable directory name (`7x` for the shipped packages) | Enforced (`invalid_vendor`) | `eZPackageRequestGuard::isSafeName()` |
| [ ] | `<summary>`, `<description>`, `<state>` present | Convention | Shown by the package page and the setup wizard |
| [ ] | `<maintainers>` with a role from `[MaintainerSettings] RoleList[]` | Convention | 15 of the 16 shipped packages name a `lead` (`sevenx_extension` has no `<maintainers>`) |

Details: [Required package.xml fields](package-xml-required-fields.md), [Version numbers](version-numbers.md).

## A site package in the setup wizard

| | Requirement | Label | Checked in |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ ] | `<type value="site" />` | Enforced (otherwise not listed) | `eZStepSiteTypes::fetchAvailableSitePackages()` filters on type `site` |
| [ ] | `install_type="import"` on `<package>` | Convention | All 5 shipped site packages; a site package is imported, not installed |
| [ ] | Every required package is in the same `index.xml` with a `url` | Enforced ("the URL is unknown") | `eZStepSiteTypes::downloadDependantPackages()` |
| [ ] | Every required package can be fetched and installed | Enforced (`EZSW-050`, `EZSW-051`) | `eZStepCreateSites` |
| [ ] | Each `<require>` has `type="ezpackage"`, `name` and `min-version` | Enforced: the create sites step installs only `type="ezpackage"` requirements; the kickstart path reads `min-version` without a fallback | `ezstep_create_sites.php`, `ezstep_site_types.php` |
| [ ] | Every file named by `<settings-file filename>` exists in `settings/` | Convention (a missing one is skipped silently) | `ezstep_create_sites.php` (`file_exists()` before `include_once`) |

Details: [Declaring dependencies](declaring-dependencies.md).

## The index entry

| | Requirement | Label |
|---|---|---|
| [ ] | `name`, `type` and `url` attributes on the `<package>` element of `index.xml` | Enforced: `name` is the key, `type="site"` lists it, `url` is downloaded |
| [ ] | `summary`, `description`, `version` attributes | Convention: shown on the site type step as "summary (ver. version)" |
| [ ] | `thumbnail_url` pointing at `thumbnails/<name>.png` | Convention: shown before the package is imported |

Details: [The index.xml format](../package-server/the-index-xml-format.md),
[Thumbnails and screenshots](thumbnails-and-screenshots.md).

## Documents and descriptions

| | Requirement | Label |
|---|---|---|
| [ ] | `<licence>` with a license identifier | Convention (only the creation wizards insist on it) |
| [ ] | `documents/LICENCE`, named in `<documents>` | Convention: all 16 shipped packages |
| [ ] | One `<changelog><entry>` per release, with `timestamp`, `person`, `release` and one `<change>` per change | Convention |
| [ ] | A thumbnail in the file collection `default` | Convention: shown by the wizard and the package page |

Details: [License and documents](license-and-documents.md), [Changelog entries](changelog-entries.md).

## Before publishing

- [ ] `xmllint --noout package.xml` prints nothing.
- [ ] `php ezpm.php validate <archive>` ends in `PASS`.
- [ ] The archive uploads on `package/upload` of a test installation.
- [ ] A fresh install with the package succeeds in a sandbox.

Details: [Validating a package before publishing](validating-a-package-before-publishing.md),
[Testing in a sandbox](../your-own/testing-in-a-sandbox.md).

## The source repository

- [ ] A README that says what the package installs and how to build it (Convention).
- [ ] A LICENSE file at the root (Convention).
- [ ] Commit subjects with `Added:`, `Updated:`, `Removed:`, `Renamed:` prefixes (Convention).

Details: [README and repository docs](readme-and-repository-docs.md).
